experiment.hypothesis: The documented contract requires runBatch to immediately serve every configured worker without queueing, while acquireBatch must reject requests over capacity. When pool capacity is reduced below the configured worker concurrency (capacity=4, concurrency=6), runBatch calls acquireBatch(concurrency) and throws "capacity exhausted", violating the contract that runBatch must serve every configured worker immediately.
experiment.trigger: Import acceptance/catcher-pair/worker.mjs and call runBatch() once in a configuration where concurrency exceeds capacity (the combined interaction change).
experiment.expected: runBatch() returns an array of length equal to concurrency (serves every worker immediately) and does not throw; additionally, acquireBatch(concurrency+1) rejects/throws when requested count exceeds capacity.

oracle.quote: runBatch must serve every configured worker immediately without queueing; acquireBatch must reject requests over capacity.
